title: EpistemicModelRecord
description: JSON Schema governing machine-readable epistemic provenance records across Oklo Pool Mobile and Planetary Explorer v2 models.

model_id.description: Unique machine-readable identifier for the model or data record.

model_version.description: Semantic version of the model specification or implementation.

evidence_class.description: One of the six immutable epistemic evidence classes defined in Requirement R7.

source_repository.description: Canonical URL or identifier of the source repository.

source_commit.description: Git commit SHA pinning the exact source code state.

specification_version.description: Formal specification or pre-registration document version governing the model.

run_receipt.description: Relative path or cryptographic digest of the verified run receipt, or null if uncomputed.

parameter_set_id.description: Identifier referencing the exact parameter set used for this model run.

units.description: Explicit physical or dimensionless units. Must never be ambiguous.

coordinate_system.description: Explicit coordinate frame (e.g. WGS84, cartesian_local_16m_cube, lattice_indices_32x32x32).

uncertainty.description: Quantified error bounds, confidence intervals, sensitivity bounds, or null.

known_limitations.description: Mandatory disclosure of simplifying assumptions, domain boundaries, and invalid extrapolations.
